title: A board outline of four loose lines with an opening drawn as a rectangle, an opening drawn as a polygon and a line that closes nothing
how: On Edge.Cuts: four `gr_line` that join end to end (0,0), (40,0), (40,20), (0,20) and close = one ring of 4 points, 40 x 20 mm = 800 mm2;
a `gr_rect` from (5,5) to (10,10) is a ring of 4 points (25 mm2) and a `gr_poly` of 3 points (20,5), (30,5), (25,12) is a ring (35 mm2 = 10 x 7 / 2);
the largest ring is the outline, and both other rings have every corner inside it, so 2 openings of the board;
the line from (100,100) to (110,100) joins nothing: 1 piece that does not close, dropped;
no footprint, no net used, no track: only the layer table gives the 2 copper layers.
